brief:
President Donald Trump faces the midterm elections with limited foreign policy achievements, as major international conflicts remain unresolved, according to Al-Monitor reporting on Reuters analysis. The Iran situation has devolved into a costly standoff, while crises spanning Ukraine to Gaza persist without diplomatic or military resolution. Trump's expansive foreign policy agenda has stalled as the campaign season intensifies.

The unresolved conflicts present significant political challenges for the administration heading into voting. Multiple international hotspots continue to demand attention without clear breakthroughs to showcase domestically. Foreign policy traditionally plays a secondary role in midterm campaigns, yet Trump's inability to claim concrete victories abroad leaves his administration vulnerable to criticism on the global stage.

title: Trump enters midterms without major foreign policy victories
